description: Chantiers de voirie communaux Charleroi 2021 is a dataset listed in Open Data Wallonie Bruxelles, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Charleroi. Informations sur les chantiers communaux réalisés, programmés et en cours en 2021 sur le territoire de la Ville de Charleroi: objet du chantier, accès à la circulation, déviations mises en place, calendrier prévisionnel. Coverage: Wallonia and Brussels. The portal files it under Administration and Public Services. Its keywords are travail, voirie, mobilité. The portal shows 62 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2025-07-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-www-odwb-be-portal.
